articles.title: NASA Tests Dual Mode Propulsion CubeSat Ahead of Launch
articles.summary: Spacecraft propulsion traditionally relies on volatile fuels and separate, bulky systems for different types of maneuvering in space. NASA is working to change that paradigm. articles.title: ESA and the EU partner with Museo Galileo on new exhibition
articles.summary: The European Space Agency (ESA), Italy’s Museo Galileo - Institute and Museum of the History of Science, and the European Commission (EC) have partnered to uncover the surprising and far-reaching connections between the pioneer astronomer Galileo Galilei and Europe’s satellite navigation system Galileo.
